title: 區域能源負載預測~District-energy load forecasting
focus: 可追溯時序、基準模型與不確定負載~Traceable time series, baselines and uncertain demand
summary: 以「可追溯時序、基準模型與不確定負載」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow traceable time series, baselines and uncertain demand through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 功率與能量區別~Distinguish power and energy
units.mechanism: 電表區間能量需除時間才能形成平均功率；不同採樣頻率需統一。~Divide interval energy by duration to get mean power and harmonize sampling intervals.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：P=E/dt;E=25kWh;dt=0.25h；計算 25/0.25 = 100 kW。適用限制：區間平均，不是瞬時峰值。~Original hypothetical teaching example: P=E/dt;E=25kWh;dt=0.25h; calculation 25/0.25 = 100 kW. Applicability: Interval mean, not instantaneous peak.
units.verify: 把15分鐘資料聚合到小時並檢查能量守恆。~Aggregate15-minute data hourly and verify energy conservation.
units.failure: 直接相加功率卻不乘時間會弄錯日能耗。~Summing powers without time miscalculates daily energy.
units.misconception: kW和kWh是同一物理量。~kW and kWh are the same quantity.
units.practice: 在「功率與能量區別」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 100 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「直接相加功率卻不乘時間會弄錯日能耗。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for distinguish power and energy, first reproduce 100 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Summing powers without time miscalculates daily energy." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 時區與缺測~Time zones and missing intervals
units.mechanism: 時區、日光節約與遺漏區間會造成重複或空洞；須保存原始時間戳。~Time zones, daylight saving and missing intervals cause duplicates or gaps; retain original timestamps.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：coverage=observed intervals/expected;92/96；計算 92/96 = 0.958333 fraction。適用限制：示例24小時的15分鐘資料。~Original hypothetical teaching example: coverage=observed intervals/expected;92/96; calculation 92/96 = 0.958333 fraction. Applicability: Illustrative24-hour day of15-minute data.
units.verify: 造一個缺測區間，標記而不把它當零負載。~Create a missing interval and flag it rather than treating it as zero.
units.failure: 補零會讓模型學到不存在的停機。~Zero-filling teaches a shutdown that never occurred.
units.misconception: 缺測電表值就等於用電為零。~A missing meter value means zero consumption.
units.practice: 在「時區與缺測」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.958333 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「補零會讓模型學到不存在的停機。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for time zones and missing intervals, first reproduce 0.958333 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Zero-filling teaches a shutdown that never occurred." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 季節性樸素基準~Seasonal naive baseline
units.mechanism: 先以同星期同時段或前一日建立可解釋基準，再判斷複雜模型是否改善。~Establish an interpretable same-weekday/time or previous-day baseline before judging complex models.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：absolute error=abs(actual-baseline);abs(110-100)；計算 abs(110-100) = 10 kW。適用限制：單一時點誤差。~Original hypothetical teaching example: absolute error=abs(actual-baseline);abs(110-100); calculation abs(110-100) = 10 kW. Applicability: Single-point error.
units.verify: 比較昨日同時與上週同時兩個基準。~Compare previous-day and previous-week baselines.
units.failure: 沒有基準就宣稱AI較好缺乏比較依據。~Claiming superior AI without a baseline lacks comparison.
units.misconception: 模型越複雜就必定勝過樸素基準。~A more complex model always beats a naive baseline.
units.practice: 在「季節性樸素基準」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 10 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「沒有基準就宣稱AI較好缺乏比較依據。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for seasonal naive baseline, first reproduce 10 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Claiming superior AI without a baseline lacks comparison." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 氣象與度時~Weather and degree-hours
units.mechanism: 冷暖需求可用基準溫度以上或以下的度時描述，但轉折和用途需要資料校正。~Degree-hours above or below a base describe demand, but breakpoints and use require calibration.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：cooling degree-hours=max(T-Tbase,0)*dt;T=30;Tbase=24;dt=1h；計算 max(30-24,0)*1 = 6 K h。適用限制：單時段線性特徵，不是完整建築模型。~Original hypothetical teaching example: cooling degree-hours=max(T-Tbase,0)*dt;T=30;Tbase=24;dt=1h; calculation max(30-24,0)*1 = 6 K h. Applicability: One-interval linear feature, not a full building model.
units.verify: 改變基準溫度，檢查不同季節殘差。~Change base temperature and inspect seasonal residuals.
units.failure: 使用預測時尚未知的實測未來天氣會造成資料洩漏。~Using unavailable future observed weather causes leakage.
units.misconception: 模型訓練可任意使用未來實測資料作即時特徵。~Training may freely use future measurements as real-time features.
units.practice: 在「氣象與度時」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 6 K h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「使用預測時尚未知的實測未來天氣會造成資料洩漏。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for weather and degree-hours, first reproduce 6 K h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using unavailable future observed weather causes leakage." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 線性可解釋模型~Interpretable linear model
units.mechanism: 基載、天氣和占用項提供可檢查的貢獻，係數須由訓練集估計。~Baseload, weather and occupancy give inspectable contributions; estimate coefficients from training data.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：P=b0+bT*CDH+bOcc*Occ;b0=40;bT=5;CDH=6;bOcc=20;Occ=1；計算 40+5*6+20*1 = 90 kW。適用限制：假想係數，未經真實場址校正。~Original hypothetical teaching example: P=b0+bT*CDH+bOcc*Occ;b0=40;bT=5;CDH=6;bOcc=20;Occ=1; calculation 40+5*6+20*1 = 90 kW. Applicability: Hypothetical coefficients without real-site calibration.
units.verify: 停用占用項並比較工作日與假日偏差。~Remove occupancy and compare weekday/weekend bias.
units.failure: 把係數因果化可能忽略天氣和占用的相關性。~Interpreting coefficients causally can miss correlated inputs.
units.misconception: 回歸係數永遠能直接解釋物理因果。~A regression coefficient always proves physical causation.
units.practice: 在「線性可解釋模型」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 90 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把係數因果化可能忽略天氣和占用的相關性。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for interpretable linear model, first reproduce 90 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Interpreting coefficients causally can miss correlated inputs." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 時間外驗證~Out-of-time validation
units.mechanism: 依時間先後切分，避免相鄰時間或未來資料洩漏到訓練；超參數需在驗證集選。~Split chronologically to avoid future and adjacent-window leakage; select hyperparameters on validation data.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：test fraction=test days/total days;30/180；計算 30/180 = 0.166667 fraction。適用限制：示意切分比例，不是通用最佳比例。~Original hypothetical teaching example: test fraction=test days/total days;30/180; calculation 30/180 = 0.166667 fraction. Applicability: Illustrative split, not a universal optimum.
units.verify: 用滾動起點依序預測下一週。~Use rolling origins to predict each next week.
units.failure: 隨機打散強季節資料可能高估未來預測能力。~Random shuffling of seasonal data can overstate future performance.
units.misconception: 所有時間序列都應隨機打散後測試。~Every time series should be tested after random shuffling.
units.practice: 在「時間外驗證」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.166667 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「隨機打散強季節資料可能高估未來預測能力。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for out-of-time validation, first reproduce 0.166667 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Random shuffling of seasonal data can overstate future performance." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: MAE與尖峰誤差~MAE and peak errors
units.mechanism: 平均絕對誤差描述典型偏差，但調度還需關心尖峰低估與時刻錯位。~MAE describes typical error, while dispatch also needs peak underprediction and timing error.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：MAE=(10+5+15)/3；計算 (10+5+15)/3 = 10 kW。適用限制：三個假想誤差樣本。~Original hypothetical teaching example: MAE=(10+5+15)/3; calculation (10+5+15)/3 = 10 kW. Applicability: Three hypothetical error samples.
units.verify: 分別報尖峰時段和非尖峰時段MAE。~Report MAE separately for peak and off-peak periods.
units.failure: 平均誤差小仍可能在最重要尖峰嚴重低估。~Small average error can coexist with severe peak underprediction.
units.misconception: MAE小即可保證每一個尖峰都預測準確。~Small MAE guarantees every peak is accurate.
units.practice: 在「MAE與尖峰誤差」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 10 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「平均誤差小仍可能在最重要尖峰嚴重低估。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for mae and peak errors, first reproduce 10 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Small average error can coexist with severe peak underprediction." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 預測區間與涵蓋率~Prediction intervals and coverage
units.mechanism: 區間寬度與涵蓋率需一起報告；只報點預測無法表達調度風險。~Report width with coverage; a point forecast alone cannot express dispatch uncertainty.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：coverage=inside intervals/total;18/20；計算 18/20 = 0.9 fraction。適用限制：有限樣本的經驗涵蓋率。~Original hypothetical teaching example: coverage=inside intervals/total;18/20; calculation 18/20 = 0.9 fraction. Applicability: Empirical coverage from a finite sample.
units.verify: 比較窄區間與寬區間的漏包情況。~Compare missed observations under narrow and wide intervals.
units.failure: 不斷加寬區間可提高涵蓋卻降低操作價值。~Widening intervals raises coverage while reducing usefulness.
units.misconception: 涵蓋率高就代表區間一定精準而且實用。~High coverage automatically means precise useful intervals.
units.practice: 在「預測區間與涵蓋率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.9 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「不斷加寬區間可提高涵蓋卻降低操作價值。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for prediction intervals and coverage, first reproduce 0.9 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Widening intervals raises coverage while reducing usefulness." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 概念漂移與重新校正~Concept drift and recalibration
units.mechanism: 設備更新、作息與氣候改變會讓歷史關係失效；需監測殘差而非自動永久相信模型。~Equipment, schedules and climate change historical relationships; monitor residuals rather than trust the model indefinitely.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：bias=mean residual;(8+10+12)/3；計算 (8+10+12)/3 = 10 kW。適用限制：三時點平均偏差。~Original hypothetical teaching example: bias=mean residual;(8+10+12)/3; calculation (8+10+12)/3 = 10 kW. Applicability: Mean bias over three points.
units.verify: 模擬新增一台設備，檢查殘差是否持續偏正。~Simulate an added load and check sustained positive residuals.
units.failure: 只用全歷史平均誤差可能稀釋近期漂移。~An all-history mean can dilute recent drift.
units.misconception: 模型訓練一次就能永久適用所有設備狀況。~A model trained once works forever for all equipment states.
units.practice: 在「概念漂移與重新校正」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 10 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只用全歷史平均誤差可能稀釋近期漂移。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for concept drift and recalibration, first reproduce 10 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "An all-history mean can dilute recent drift." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 預測轉為儲能調度~Translate forecasts into storage dispatch
units.mechanism: 預測需受功率、能量、效率和服務條件約束；不確定度應保留到決策。~Forecasts must respect power, energy, efficiency and service constraints; carry uncertainty into decisions.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：required delivered energy=(Ppeak-Plimit)*duration;(150-120)*2；計算 (150-120)*2 = 60 kWh。適用限制：理想負載削峰，不含充放損失。~Original hypothetical teaching example: required delivered energy=(Ppeak-Plimit)*duration;(150-120)*2; calculation (150-120)*2 = 60 kWh. Applicability: Ideal delivered peak shaving before charging/discharging losses.
units.verify: 加入效率與容量限制，檢查是否仍可削峰。~Add efficiency and capacity limits and check feasibility.
units.failure: 把預測峰值直接當充放電命令會忽略儲能狀態。~Using forecast peaks directly as dispatch ignores storage state.
units.misconception: 只要能預測尖峰，就一定有足夠設備消除尖峰。~Predicting a peak guarantees enough equipment to eliminate it.
units.practice: 在「預測轉為儲能調度」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 60 kWh，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把預測峰值直接當充放電命令會忽略儲能狀態。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for translate forecasts into storage dispatch, first reproduce 60 kWh, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using forecast peaks directly as dispatch ignores storage state." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
